# Slate Sources

This directory contains compiled research summaries derived from the official
Slate repo and docs at `zbeyens/slate@945a484df2497e4c448b33f417b0de2a49840032` and `https://docs.slatejs.org`.

Current pages:

- [walkthrough-concepts-and-api-doc-patterns.md](docs/research/sources/slate/walkthrough-concepts-and-api-doc-patterns.md)

This layer is source-oriented. It is not yet the final decision layer.

Decisions:

- [Document import and conversion fidelity](../../decisions/import-fidelity.md). Plate/Plite format parse, diagnostics and admission contract, with a validation benchmark comparing ProseMirror, CKEditor, Slate, Lexical and Tiptap.
- [Plugin input rules guide should lead with runtime first then feature owners then API reference](../../decisions/plugin-input-rules-guide-should-lead-with-runtime-first-then-feature-owners-then-api-reference.md). Plate docs-structure decision that compares the Tiptap, Slate, Lexical and ProseMirror documentation patterns.
- [Slate v2 destructive leaf-boundary deletion should own leaf cleanup before render](../../decisions/slate-v2-destructive-leaf-boundary-legacy-parity.md). Slate v2 (Plite) leaf cleanup rule against legacy Slate's zero-width leaf behavior.
- [Slate v2 Editing Epoch Legacy Timing Recovery Audit](../../decisions/slate-v2-editing-epoch-legacy-timing-recovery-audit.md). Maps legacy Slate Editable browser timing rules onto Slate v2 input/selection owners.
- [Slate v2 Node Query API Should Keep Lazy Entries, Early-Exit Helpers, And Explicit Materialization](../../decisions/slate-v2-node-query-api-should-keep-lazy-entries-and-add-first-match-helpers.md). Slate v2 node-query API decision with a reference table comparing legacy Slate, ProseMirror, Lexical and Tiptap traversal APIs.
- [Slate v2 overlay architecture beats legacy Slate and aligns with the best parts of the field](../../decisions/slate-v2-overlay-superiority-vs-legacy-and-field.md). Judges the April 2026 Slate v2 overlay design against legacy Slate and against ProseMirror, Lexical and Tiptap, one section each.
- [Slate v2 post-closure architecture review](../../decisions/slate-v2-post-closure-architecture-review.md). Plite post-closure review: no pivot to Lexical, ProseMirror or Tiptap, and a typing-lane comparison against legacy Slate chunking.

Research runs:

- [2026-06-12-huge-doc-native-selection](../../../plite/research/2026-06-12-huge-doc-native-selection). Plite huge-document vertical selection and its benchmark packets, compared with ProseMirror's native-first geometry, Lexical's model select-all and dirty selection, legacy Slate's chunking example, and Tiptap as a ProseMirror duplicate.
- [2026-06-12-oss-history-undo-architecture](../../../plite/research/2026-06-12-oss-history-undo-architecture). Compares prosemirror-history skipped-edit remapping, Lexical merge/composition policy and legacy Slate adjacent merge, then adds a Plite history contract row.
- [2026-06-14-firefox-inline-selection-mouseup](../../../plite/research/2026-06-14-firefox-inline-selection-mouseup). ProseMirror pointer-selection sync, Lexical selection restore, an upstream Slate skipped inline row and WPT fixtures are compared against Plite's Firefox inline-link repair.
- [2026-06-14-firefox-inline-void-select-all-replacement](../../../plite/research/2026-06-14-firefox-inline-void-select-all-replacement). Plite Firefox inline-void select-all fix, compared with ProseMirror atom selection import, CodeMirror atomic ranges, WPT and upstream Slate's mention wrapper.
- [2026-06-14-selection-triple-click-inline-normalization](../../../plite/research/2026-06-14-selection-triple-click-inline-normalization). Plite triple-click and inline selection proof repair, based on Lexical selection-normalization source and classic Slate's Editor.unhangRange docs.
- [2026-08-17-editor-node-model-standards](../../../plite/research/2026-08-17-editor-node-model-standards). Plate's persisted node model (headings, code, lists, media, tables, identity) compared field by field with MDAST/UNIST, ProseMirror, Lexical, Slate (source plus 14 issue/PR threads), BlockNote, Portable Text, Editor.js and Quill.
- [2026-09-09-editor-performance-iteration-2](../../../plite/research/2026-09-09-editor-performance-iteration-2). Experiments E01–E26 cover Plite mount, publication, selectors, decoration manager and virtualization, Plate features and the React Compiler (plite); a nine-editor full-DOM comparison, Wordgard/ProseKit concept matrices and CodeMirror/VS Code mechanisms make it comparative (editor-architecture); it states Wordgard keymap precedence, text chunks, central-authority OT and table-map facts (wordgard), ProseKit derived-value hook, page rendering and virtual-selection test facts (prosekit), Slate chunk-on baseline and move/remove timings (slate), and lower ProseMirror 10k mount/structural times plus ProseKit's delegation to ProseMirror view and history (prosemirror).
- [2026-09-11-large-documents-contract](../../../plite/research/2026-09-11-large-documents-contract). Plite large-document rendering, pagination, coverage and packaging contract, with pinned source reads of ProseMirror viewdesc (composing-node identity), Lexical's reconciler, the Slate chunking walkthrough, and CodeMirror and TanStack as cross-editor evidence.
- [2026-10-02-agentic-e2e-testing](../../../plite/research/2026-10-02-agentic-e2e-testing). Mostly Plate proof tooling: it judges tester-army e2e and the mobile agent tools against @platejs/test and the Playwright suites, then builds Plite's local Android Gboard and macOS Pinyin lanes, audits Plite's `__pliteBrowserHandle`, and drafts Plite IME bugs (plite); shard 005 and about 79 read-log rows rank Android cases from Slate's issue tracker and read Slate's android-input-manager, RestoreDOM, android-tests page and Playwright config (slate); shard 006 cites Lexical's CDP imeSetComposition e2e and ProseMirror's synthetic CompositionEvent tests as prior art (lexical, prosemirror) and compares how editors test IME, concluding none drives a real OS IME (editor-architecture).
- [2026-10-02-autocomplete-query-representation](../../../plite/research/2026-10-02-autocomplete-query-representation). Compares where trigger autocomplete keeps its query across editors, with source-cited facts on Lexical, Slate, Tiptap, ProseKit, Milkdown and ProseMirror (prosemirror-view, inputrules, issue #903), plus Plate's own probes and the history of its 2024 combobox design, ending in a Plate autocomplete verdict.
- [2026-10-02-dnd-landing-policy](../../../plite/research/2026-10-02-dnd-landing-policy). Plite transfer landing pipeline and Plate DnD feature rules mapped file by file, then compared with source-read drop-target, handle and container policy in ProseMirror, Tiptap, BlockNote, Lexical, ProseKit, Slate (zbeyens fork) and CKEditor 5.
- [2026-10-02-dnd-library-choice](../../../plite/research/2026-10-02-dnd-library-choice). Keeps Plite's native drag driver and transfer owner and the copied DndKit over Pragmatic DnD, dnd-kit and React DnD, and a cross-editor table states drag implementation and test-limit facts for ProseMirror, Tiptap, Lexical, a Slate fork and BlockNote.
